While investigating multivariate industrial telemetry, I found that conventional attention mechanisms collapse when underlying system dynamics shift—motivating me to design a neural-ODE coupled spectral forecaster that reduced long-range drift by 17.4%. Yet passive sequence forecasting only observes how a system evolves; intelligent physical agents must actively intervene within that loop, where every motor command alters future state distributions.
